transcript.answer: Before 2026-09-23 the Gemini pods had no MCP tools for two reasons. First, gemini-cli has no MCP flag and reads MCP servers only from its settings files. The subsystem rendered a recipe's `mcp_servers` only for Claude, so Gemini pods got no Lore MCP at all. Second, the v0.11.2 fix (lore #2133, subsystem #240) wrote the servers to a system-scope settings file named by `GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH` (`/agent/.ai-agent/gemini-settings.json`). gemini-cli refuses a system settings file unless its parent directory is root-owned, and the pod runs as uid 1000. It printed 'Security Warning: Skipping system settings file' and started with 'init … (0 tools)'. Subsystem v0.11.3 (#246, deployed through lore #2144) fixed this by merging the servers into the user settings file `/agent/.gemini/settings.json`. A Gemini run on 2026-09-23 then made Lore MCP calls.
